jobs.description:
At Luna Innovations, we measure and manage light in optical fiber. Our Optics/Polarization product line, based in Chino, CA, specializes in industry-leading components, modules, and test equipment for the characterization and control of optical polarization. Our instruments, ranging from dynamic optical delay/phase management and high-speed polarization state management to full-function polarization light analyzers, are critical for optical communications, silicon photonics testing, and fiber optic sensing.

At Luna, you will work with some of the most curious, forward-thinking engineers and scientists in the industry to shape the future of fiber optic measurement.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Software Engineer II, with flexibility to hire at the Senior level for the right candidate, to join the software development team for our photonics instrumentation. Final level and pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications. You will build the applications that control precision optical instruments, process high-speed measurement data, and visualize complex optical behavior in real time. You will develop software for Linux and Windows platforms, including embedded Linux devices, and support the remote control interfaces customers use to integrate our instruments into their own test systems.

If you are passionate about hardware-software integration and want to build the software behind state-of-the-art optical test equipment, we want you on our team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Application Development:** Design, develop, and maintain reliable C/C++ and Python applications for Linux and Windows, including user-facing applications and GUIs.
* **Software Architecture:** Design maintainable, modular software components and interfaces for hardware-integrated products; evaluate performance, reliability, and lifecycle trade-offs.
* **Embedded Linux:** Develop and integrate software on embedded and headless Linux platforms, including cross-compilation and system integration.
* **Software Infrastructure & Lifecycle:** Improve build and release processes, automated testing, packaging, deployment, Linux updates, security patch management, and long-term maintenance.
* **Remote Control & SDKs:** Develop and support APIs, SDKs, and remote control interfaces that enable customers to integrate our instruments into automated manufacturing and test systems.
* **Software Quality & Documentation:** Apply code review, testing, debugging, validation, versioning, and technical documentation practices throughout development and release.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with optical, electrical, firmware, and systems engineers, as well as manufacturing and support teams, to define instrument capabilities, troubleshoot prototypes, and bring new products to market.

**Required Qualifications: Software Engineer II**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software on Linux.
* Experience with multithreading, memory management, and optimizing code for performance.
* Experience with Git/GitHub workflows, version control, collaborative development, and code review.
* Familiarity with software build systems, debugging tools, unit testing, and validation.
* Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and ability to work across software/hardware boundaries.
* Effective technical communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented, Agile environment.

**Additional Required Qualifications: Senior Software Engineer**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability to design and maintain complex C/C++ software systems.
* Experience designing software architecture for embedded, hardware-integrated, or other equipment products.
* Experience setting up or owning build, test, and release processes for a software product.
* Strong Linux development experience, including system-level debugging and deployment.
* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: cross-compilation and system integration; embedded Linux platforms, BSPs, or SDKs; or Linux platform lifecyclemaintenance.
* Ability to own complex technical problems, lead design decisions, and mentor engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Yocto Project, Buildroot, toolchains, root filesystem customization, or reproducible embedded Linux builds.
* Experience with secure software update and deployment systems, rollback/recovery, and remote device or fleet management.
* Experience with Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, or upstream patch integration.
* Experience with instrument communication protocols and interfaces.
* Experience developing lightweight web-based GUIs and web server applications for embedded Linux or network-connected devices.
* Experience building GUIs for scientific or test and measurement equipment; Qt experience a plus.
* Experience implementing numerical computing, signal processing, or control algorithms.
* Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. --------------

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. We turn high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical machines: rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, and defense platforms. Founded by former SpaceX engineers, we are building the review and analysis layer for the AI era of physical systems.

**About The Role**
------------------

Sift is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and own the developer infrastructure and testing environments that enable our engineers to ship software faster and with greater confidence.  
You'll design systems that allow engineers to spin up complete, production-like environments on demand to test changes, simulate real-world workloads, and validate correctness. As AI coding agents become increasingly integrated into development workflows, you'll build the infrastructure that enables these agents to independently test, debug, and validate the code they produce.  
Sift processes high-volume telemetry from complex hardware systems, making realistic testing environments particularly challenging. This is a foundational, high-ownership opportunity to architect and scale the infrastructure that powers how we develop, test, and ship software.

**In This Role, You'll:**
=========================

* Design and build infrastructure that provisions isolated, production-like testing environments on demand, enabling engineers to validate changes against Sift's full application stack.
* Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and deployment automation to make testing environments fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.
* Develop infrastructure that supports diverse testing workloads, including integration testing, correctness validation, load testing, and performance testing.
* Build tooling for realistic data generation and user behavior simulation to validate software under production-like conditions.
* Enable AI coding agents to interact with testing environments, execute tests, and validate code changes autonomously.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to understand developer needs, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve development velocity and software quality.

==============================

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in developer infrastructure, test infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer tooling.
* Deep hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, build systems, and deploying applications to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience building and automating developer infrastructure, deployment systems, or testing environments, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and reliability.
* Experience developing or optimizing CI/CD pipelines and automating infrastructure provisioning and deployments.
* Strong software engineering and programming skills, preferably in Go or Python.
* Ability to balance infrastructure performance, environment fidelity, reliability, and cost.
* Strong collaboration skills and a developer-focused mindset, with experience building tools that improve engineering productivity.

=================

* Load testing, performance testing, or distributed test execution.

At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you!

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About Hapiko**

Hapiko makes Stickerbox, a voice-activated sticker printer for kids. A child says whatever they can imagine, and seconds later it's a real sticker in their hand. Hapiko is a Spin Master company, so we pair a small, senior engineering team with the reach of one of the world's largest toy companies.

**What will you work on?**

You'll own everything behind that moment: the real-time connection layer, the API, the job pipeline and the cloud infrastructure every device talks to. We're a small team building a first-of-its-kind product and scaling it globally, and the backend has to stay fast, safe for kids and affordable as we grow.

* Own the API and job queues that every sticker request runs through.
* Keep the real-time connection layer that devices rely on healthy and reliable, partnering with our firmware engineer.
* Tune and extend autoscaling so the system handles holiday spikes and a growing fleet, partnering with our ML Serving engineer on GPU inference.
* Mature our observability: metrics, logs, tracing and alerts that tell us what's wrong before families do.
* Build cost instrumentation so we can see what each request, model and service actually costs.
* Own release engineering for server-side services, including safe deploys, database migrations and fast rollback.
* Partner with our Trust Safety engineer on abuse prevention, device security and privacy for a kids' product.
* Share on-call and make the rotation quieter over time.

**What are your skills and experience?**

* Depth in Python and PostgreSQL.
* Elixir experience, or real interest in learning it.
* You've owned production infrastructure end to end, not just written code that runs on it.
* You've scaled a queue-driven or real-time system through an order of magnitude of traffic growth.
* You're comfortable being paged for systems you own, and you work to make that happen less.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to independently build and maintain intelligent automation solutions focused on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) in the healthcare industry, with a specialization in computer vision-driven RPA. * OCR & Document Extraction: Apply OCR and document-parsing techniques to extract structured data from scanned EOBs, remittance advices, correspondence, and payer documents.
* Web Automation: Build and maintain Selenium-based automations for payer portals, EHR web interfaces, and other browser-based workflows as a secondary but important part of the role.
* Automation Development: Deliver robust Python automation scripts for RCM processes with limited supervision, following team coding standards and review practices.
* AI/ML Integration: Apply AI/ML techniques (e.g., OCR, NLP, predictive analytics) to enhance automation quality and improve process outcomes.
* System Integration: Integrate automation solutions with billing software, EHR systems, and healthcare web portals independently.
* Compliance: Ensure all automation adheres to healthcare data privacy and security regulations (e.g., HIPAA).
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for automation workflows you own.
* Monitoring & Optimization: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations for accuracy, efficiency, and reliability — particularly for CV-based workflows that are sensitive to UI drift and image variability.
* Resilience: Build automation workflows that integrate reliably with legacy desktop systems, Citrix/virtual environments, and modern web platforms.
* Collaboration: Work alongside SMEs and operations teams to translate manual workflows into digital automation.
* Security: Maintain secure credential handling, logging, and audit trails consistent with HITRUST/HIPAA compliance.
* Cloud Services: Leverage Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Key Vault) to build scalable automation.

  

* Strong proficiency in Python programming.
* Hands-on, production experience with OpenCV for image recognition, template matching, and visual data extraction.
* Experience with image-based desktop automation libraries (e.g., PyAutoGUI) and comfort automating applications that expose no API or DOM.
* Working experience with Selenium for browser-based automation.
* Working knowledge of healthcare RCM workflows (e.g., billing, coding, claims, denial management).
* Solid understanding of HIPAA and healthcare security best practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.
* Effective communicator with both technical and non-technical teams.
* Proficiency with version control tools (e.g., Git).
* 2+ years of professional software development experience in Python or a closely related language.
* Ability to ramp quickly in a contract engagement and deliver production work with limited onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to complex data and workflow scenarios, including non-deterministic visual environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Practical experience with OCR engines (e.g., Tesseract, PaddleOCR) or cloud document-intelligence services.
